subject: Renewal boarding pass: timeline & QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Aditi Shah <aditi@novapay.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@novapay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal boarding pass: timeline & QBR scheduling

Aditi / Raj —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. As we discussed, I wanted to get a short kickoff thread going to align on the renewal path (term change from 12 -> 24 months), the planned throughput uplift, and lock a QBR window to review capacity, costs, and the rollout plan. TL;DR asks at the bottom.

High-level plan (proposed):
- Week of Aug 9: internal scoping and draft MAP (attached: Novapay_MAP_v2.pdf)
- Week of Aug 16: legal/procurement check-in (surface procurement contact and standard SOW redlines)
- Aug 23–30: QBR (90 minutes) with exec & engineering stakeholders; objective: confirm commit, staffing, and go-live milestone

Stakeholders (please correct):
- Novapay: Aditi Shah (platform lead), Raj Patel (engineering), procurement@novapay.com
- Redwood: Jordan Blake (AM), Karthik Iyer (Sales Eng), Marissa Cole (CS lead), David Kim (Infra eng) — I’ve CC’d Karthik/Marissa to help with the technical slots and agenda.

QBR slot options (pick 2):
- Tue Aug 24, 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed Aug 25, 13:00–14:30 PT
- Thu Aug 26, 09:00–10:30 PT

Please reply with the best two options and any additional stakeholders to loop in. Specific asks:
1) Confirm target commit (targeting +50% throughput / 2x token baseline for Q4) and desired term length (you mentioned 24 mo, please confirm).
2) Share procurement contact (for early legal review).
3) Any non-standard security/governance needs we should pre-surface (e.g., data residency or audit log retention beyond standard)?

I attached a short mutual action plan draft (Novapay_MAP_v2.pdf) to accelerate the scoping. Marissa — can you start a shared QBR agenda draft and calendar invite once slot chosen? Karthik — can you validate expected perf numbers and flag infra questions for David.

Thanks — speak soon,

Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: Novapay_MAP_v2.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

Subject: Re: Renewal boarding pass: timeline & QBR scheduling

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers below and a couple questions.

1) Term: We’re aligned to 24 months, pending final pricing confirmation (procurement will want a clean SOW).
2) Throughput: Confirming the +50% uplift target; Raj and I will run an internal traffic forecast and share numbers by Wed (Aug 4).
3) Procurement: Please loop in our procurement lead — Sara Kim (sara.kim@novapay.com). She’ll need the SOW redlines and the list of data handling commitments.
4) Security: We will need the audit-log retention options documented for our compliance team; please include any SOC2 audit evidence summary in your pack.

QBR slots: Wed Aug 25 (13:00–14:30 PT) and Thu Aug 26 (09:00–10:30 PT) both look workable. Prefer Wed if possible.

One more item: If we move to a 24-month commit, can you confirm the uplift pricing tiers in the MAP (the current draft shows a placeholder rate)? Procurement will want that line itemized.

Thanks — Aditi
Platform Lead, Novapay

- Karthik: can you add a pricing appendix to the MAP that maps 24-month commit tiers to the uplift buckets Aditi called out? Right now MAP_v2 uses placeholder rates.

Thanks all — Jordan
